title: Governed Multi-Tool Composition and Sequential Dynamic Analysis Chains
researchQuestion: If every dynamic tool is independently validated, sandboxed, capability-scoped, and untrusted, does composing multiple tools introduce new authority, provenance, resource, recursion, data-flow, or security failures?
centralArchitecturalInvariant: Tool composition may increase computational capability, but it must never increase authority.

authorityInvariants.rule: Composition cannot gain authority through capability union.
Composition cannot gain repository scope through stage chaining.
Composition cannot gain credentials through output propagation.
Composition cannot exceed cumulative resource limits.
Composition cannot convert untrusted observation into authority.
